arguments.summary: A critical mass credential compromise incident was detected originating from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), identified as a finance department endpoint. The host exhibited Cobalt Strike beaconing behavior to an external C2 server (198.51.100.23) at 2026-04-09T02:17:33Z, followed by suspicious lateral movement attempts via SMB and failed Kerberos authentication. Initial alert referenced source IP 10.0.5.14, but investigation revealed the true compromised host was 10.0.5.42. The source of 10.0.5.14 remains unconfirmed but may be a logging misattribution or network spoofing. Firewall rules have been implemented to block traffic from the affected host. Sandbox analysis of the payload hash returned 'clean', indicating potential evasion or fileless execution. UEBA flagged anomalous user behavior (CORP\jsmith), suggesting account compromise.
